title: Always On Guard
details:
Kalli Grace is a recently-single, rich woman. She has developed a playful bond with her dutiful bodyguard, Cliff Jensen, over the course of a few months. But when Kalli wants to invite a random hookup over, Cliff is worried for her safety. However, Kalli is resolute, so Cliff agrees to allow it provided he is able to supervise.

Later on, the hookup, Kasey Kei, arrives and starts getting frisky with Kalli as Cliff stands awkwardly 'on guard'. It becomes too awkward to bear, so Kalli invites him to join for a threesome. After some hesitation, Cliff finally lets his guard down and joins in for some fun!
